title: Standard and Variety: The Pluricentric Norm and Formal Register
goal: Use formal pan-Hispanic register (todo aquel que / quienes + subjunctive, impersonal se) to write for an international readership

items: I can use formal pan-Hispanic register (todo aquel que / quienes + subjunctive, impersonal se) to write for an international readership
I can discuss linguistic prestige, regional variants, and the cooperative role of the language academies
I can read and analyze an essay on why Spanish has no single 'correct' accent yet maintains a shared written norm
